evidence:
Walked instruction.md and both /instructions notes line by line against the frozen solution. Every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation:

SCREENS: staff get Board, Conversations and Activity views (app.js:122-126 buildViews); candidates get only a 'My applications' view (app.js:124, threads.js:27,226). Sign-in/sign-out (index.html:18-27, app.js:244-255; index.js:84-101).

ROLES/ACCESS (rules s.1, s.3 'Who may move what', s.6 'Who takes part'): 401 without session, 403 wrong role (index.js:73-81); candidate asking about another application gets 404 (index.js:121-131, 326-333, 378-385); HM limited to own job and Interview/Offer/Hired incl. reject from Interview/Offer and reopen of those (index.js:257-264; client targets() board.js:144-162); observer read-only (no write controls: canWrite board.js:9, readOnly composer threads.js:141-143; undo restricted index.js:348); HM conversation access only on own jobs, observer read, candidate own (index.js:114-120).

JOBS/CANDIDATES (s.2): recruiter-only Open a job with title, team, HM picked from HM accounts, interview places 1-50 (index.js:202-214; board.js:61-81); Add candidate with name/email/source to bottom of Applied, email format and case-insensitive duplicate refused at the email field keeping typed values (index.js:216-233; board.js:41-60); candidate-account email links the application (index.js:225).

BOARD (s.3): six stages incl. Rejected (board.js:27-31); one-stage moves, reject needs reason, Hired cannot be rejected, reopen only to rejected_from and clears reason (index.js:238-265, 311-314); ordinary controls (Move select + Move button, Up/Down) with optional drag/drop and drop-at-position (board.js:208-244, 300-319); shared persistent order (positions in SQLite, writeColumn index.js:200); Interview capacity incl. reorder always allowed and set-wide count (index.js:290-295) with header 'Interview (n of m places)' (board.js:327); version-based 409 stale refusal naming who changed the card via the card's latest activity line (index.js:241-245); optimistic move then put back with reason and focus on the card's controls (board.js:166-205); bulk select across stages, board-order arrival, all-or-nothing (board.js:277-290; index.js:274-321, 339-344); undo of own latest move incl. reject/reopen, restores stage, place and reason, refused if any card changed or Interview would overfill, single-use, superseded by a later move (index.js:348-373; board.js:291-299, 367-368).

NOTES (s.3 Internal notes): card detail with facts and notes, observer reads, recruiter any card, HM own jobs (index.js:386-398; board.js:85-141); unsaved note draft kept per user per card in localStorage (board.js:98,120; keep keyed by user id app.js:74-78).

ACTIVITY (s.4): job opened, added, moved, rejected (with reason), reopened, reordered, undone lines with actor (index.js:195-198, 211, 230, 266-271, 315-316, 366); refused actions write nothing (transactions); view newest first with All jobs / one job filter (app.js:80-120, index.js:189).

LIVE (s.5, brief para 2): SSE 'changed' on every successful write, debounced refresh (index.js:47-54, 102-107; app.js:175-207); keyed in-place patching keeps open card, note text, focus and scroll (board.js:321-341, 124-141; threads.js:36-65, 204-218).

CONVERSATIONS (s.6): plain text, line breaks kept, Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and focused after send, failed send kept with error (threads.js:184-202; index.js:418-429); opens on newest 30, 'Show earlier messages (N more)', 30 at a time with scroll anchoring (index.js:401-417; threads.js:85-87, 161-176); arrival while scrolled up keeps place and shows 'n new messages' pill, not marked read until viewed (threads.js:146-160, 177-182); per-person unread, own messages never unread, sending marks read, per-conversation badge and nav total (index.js:132-139, 159, 424-426; threads.js:225; app.js:155-164); Seen/Sent receipt on my latest message with candidate/recruiter/own-HM rules, observer excluded (index.js:143-150; threads.js:76-83); per-conversation per-user drafts survive switching, view change, reload and ended session with re-sign-in prompt pre-filled with the same email (threads.js:113,125,183; app.js:69, 232-238).

CANDIDATE VIEW (s.7): own applications with job title, team, candidate wording from seed labels, unread count; no auto-opened conversation; read model omits notes, reasons, rejected_from, positions, other candidates and activity (index.js:171-176; threads.js:7, 52-53).

RUNTIME (brief para 6-7, integration.md, s.8-9): node /app/server.js, PORT honoured, health answered before DB in a separate listener (bootstrap.js:19-24, 44-52); DB_PATH or app.db beside the app (db.js:9); seed read relative to module and loaded once (db.js:10, 61-62); solve.sh copies app to /app; seed copy identical to /assets seed (same sha256).

Runtime corroboration: raw-evidence-index artifacts hash-verified against the frozen solution bytes; qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json shows 26 scripted golden groups passing (board flows, stale refusal naming the mover, bulk/undo, live board arrival 808 ms with open card/note draft/focus kept, conversation paging/arrival/draft/Enter/seen/unread, ended-session draft, observer read-only, restart) with no page errors. This is scripted golden evidence only, not a configured judge run, Oracle grade or model score; row 17 asks only whether the reference plausibly implements every deliverable, which the source walk plus this scripted evidence establishes.

Adversarial probes: (a) a plausible broken reference that could pass this row by surface (screens present but undo ignoring reject/reopen, or stale refusal without a name) is excluded here because the server code handles reject/reopen through the same moveCards/actions path and the 409 message embeds the latest activity line with the actor's name; (b) Colderwater lesson 18 (each fix can create a new gap) checked against the newer brief items (undo of reject/reopen restores the reason, note drafts per user, ended-session draft, candidate not auto-opened): all implemented. Other lessons (hidden requirements, weights, judge prompts, public URLs, timing races, restart-check strength) bear on other rows, not on reference coverage.

Minor non-defect notes (P3, no deliverable gap): the activity view pages 50 lines with 'Show more' (a layout choice the brief leaves open); an already-open SSE stream is not re-authenticated after a session ends, but the brief's bound 'at the latest on the next action that needs the server' is met by app.js:69 and the live refresh triggered by any write.
